verdict.rationale: Milvus documents metadata filtering in search requests, applied before ANN search to narrow scope (milvus-docs-4/13), and lists metadata filtering as a feature shared across deployment modes (milvus-docs-17). However, the evidence never describes the filter expression language or the specific rich conditions the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of range operators, geo filtering, nested boolean logic, array membership operators, and independent or hands-on corroboration of filter expressiveness.
